# Aidemia

> > Aidemia is a comprehensive platform for account management, membership services, and community engagement with referral incentives.

Aidemia provides users with a centralized dashboard for managing their accounts, accessing membership features, and participating in a referral program. The platform supports user onboarding, authentication, and community features like chat and leaderboards.

## Key Topics

- Account Setup
- Membership Dashboard
- Referral Program
- User Onboarding
- Authentication
- Account Management
- Chat Feature
- Leaderboard
- Certification
- Pricing
- USD
- IBAN

## Core Platform

- [Aidemia](https://aidemia.co/app.php): Main application dashboard with account setup, membership management, and referral program
